summary: An integral k reduces to 1 modulo all chosen w iff every entry of k − 1 and of its conjugate vanishes there, iff g divides k − 1.

steps.claim: ⊆: for k in the kernel of the reduction, every entry of k − 1 maps to 0 under every reduceAboveG((i, w), b) (by intGL_map_reduceAboveG, the conjugate case through idOrInvAdjoint of 1), so g⁻¹(k − 1) is integral (inv_gIdele_smul_mem_iff). ⊇: if g⁻¹(k − 1) is integral, then every entry of k − 1 vanishes modulo every chosen w (b = false), so k reduces to 1.
steps.lean:
le_antisymm (fun _ ⟨k, h, e⟩ ↦ e ▸ ⟨k.2, ((S.inv_gIdele_smul_mem_iff ⟨_, _⟩).2 fun _ ↦
  map_eq_one.1 ((intGL_map_reduceAboveG ..).trans (by aesop)) · ·)⟩) fun k ⟨m, h⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨k, m⟩,
  funext₂ (map_eq_one.2 fun _ _ ↦ (inv_gIdele_smul_mem_iff ..).1 (by apply h) ⟨⟨·, ·⟩, false⟩), rfl⟩
